name: rvm
description: RVM uses versioned MD5 and SHA-512 checksum databases for Ruby archive validation. The full original statement also covers URL-check and Rubinius/self-update exceptions that are not established by this bounded evidence.
limitations: The retained source covers installer checksum enforcement, not release signing.
The Rubinius fallback and separate self-updater key retrieval are outside the pinned-checksum observation.
